name: Katekyo na Onee-san to Boku Ikenai Kojin Lesson
original_name: カテキョなお姉さんと僕 いけない個人レッスン
source:
The protagonist is an ordinary student who doesn't stand out at school, with few friends and no girlfriend. His older sister, Mitsuki, on the other hand, is active, sociable, has many friends, and even has a boyfriend, leading a lively student life. The protagonist had given up, thinking that he'd never be like his sister and would probably just continue living a quiet life...
But something changed in his life. An encounter with a woman.

"Nice to meet you. My name is Moriuchi Honoka, and I'll be tutoring you"

With her generous heart and gentle smile, the protagonist fell in love at first sight.

As the protagonist was stunned by this unexpected turn of events, Honoka sweetly whispered,

The protagonist's fantasy became reality, and he was in a dreamlike state as he received her erotic instruction...
